{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.70
|arg= local
|eff= local

|gr1= GUI Control - Controls Table

|descr= Takes array of row indices as a parameter and removes rows with those indices. Indices of remaining rows will be recomputed.

|s1= ctrl [[ctRemoveRows]] [index1, index2, ...]

|p1= ctrl: [[Control]]

|p2= indexN: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control ctRemoveRows [0, 1, 2];</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctAddRow]] [[ctAddHeader]] [[ctClear]] [[ctCurSel]] [[ctSetCurSel]] [[ctRowControls]] [[ctHeaderControls]] [[ctRowCount]] [[ctHeaderCount]] [[ctSetValue]] [[ctValue]] [[ctSetData]] [[ctData]] [[ctFindRowHeader]] [[ctFindHeaderRows]] [[ctRemoveHeaders]] [[ctSetRowTemplate]] [[ctSetHeaderTemplate]]
}}

{{Note
|user= 7erra
|timestamp= 20210102150500
|text= If you want to remove a row by clicking on a button in the ControlsTable make sure that the code is scheduled. Otherwise the game will crash.
